title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity fixes (v1.128.0)
author: Ava Martinez
description: This PR unifies auth and retry behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, improves streaming ergonomics (backpressure + reconnect behavior), applies parity fixes discovered during integration tests, and bumps SDK package versions to v1.128.0. Motivation: customers and internal integrations observed subtle differences in auth header expiry handling and retry backoff across SDKs, and streaming client ergonomics caused accidental resource leaks in long-lived streams. This change set: 1) Centralizes auth token refresh + header caching so all SDKs use the same refresh window and early-refresh heuristic; 2) Standardizes retryable error classification and exponential-backoff-with-jitter parameters; 3) Adds streaming helper primitives: ReadableStream iterator shim (TS), streaming generator context manager (Python), and clearer Close()/Cancel() semantics (Go); 4) Fixes parity issues: consistent error types, message framing for streaming delta events, and identical default timeouts; 5) Bumps package versions (python 1.128.0, typescript 1.128.0, go v1.128.0). Checklist: - [x] Unify auth refresh window and header caching across SDKs - [x] Implement shared retry policy and document parameters - [x] Add streaming ergonomics helpers and tests - [x] Run cross-language integration tests and fix parity mismatches - [x] Update changelogs and package versions - [x] CI green (after one rerun) Included in this single PR because the changes are tightly coupled for parity and release coordination. See commits for incremental steps and test run notes.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial unify-auth implementation; add retry policy; streaming ergonomics for each SDK; parity fixes from integration runs; version/changelog bumps and release notes.

ci_notes: Initial CI run: 3 flaky integration tests failed (streaming parity). Fixed framing and retried CI. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, lint, e2e integration, release packaging).
release_notes:
- SDKs: unified auth token refresh behavior and header caching across Python/TS/Go
- SDKs: consolidated retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter) and stabilized transient error handling
- Streaming: improved ergonomics (iterator/generator shims, idempotent Close/Cancel) and fixed message framing parity
- Bug fixes: cross-language parity fixes discovered by integration tests
- Version bump: python/typescript/go SDKs -> v1.128.0
notes_for_release_manager: Coordinated release: publish language packages in this order: python -> typescript -> go. Monitor streaming e2e on staging for 24h for any late parity regressions. The unified auth change uses the same default thresholds as discussed in ENG-4521; if customers relied on previous aggressive refresh they may see fewer token refresh calls (expected).
testing_strategy: Unit tests added per SDK (auth, retries, streaming). Cross-language integration tests in integration-tests/crosslang were extended to cover framing, backpressure, and cancelation behavior. Ran full e2e with staging inference cluster and load tests to validate retry/backoff under intermittent 503s.
compatibility_notes: All changes are backwards-compatible for common usages. There is a small window change for token refresh (early refresh heuristic) - documented and feature-flagged in the SDKs for two release cycles.
risk_assessment: Low-medium; auth and retry changes are critical but well-covered by tests. Streaming ergonomics fixed several resource-leak scenarios; high-impact if regressions but mitigations in place (feature flags + quick patch path).
